gloss: turning the tables on an attacker

definitions.gloss: turning the tables; beating one's attacker
definitions.explanation: Defeating the person who came to attack or challenge you, so that the attacker ends up beaten. Originally said of a samurai killed by the enemy he sought revenge on; now common in sports, games and everyday talk.

examples.english: To be beaten by the one you attacked.

examples.japanese: ⟦{挑戦者|ちょうせんしゃ}→挑戦者：25272_chousensha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{返|かえ}り{討|う}ちにした。
examples.english: The champion turned the tables on the challenger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝負|しょうぶ}→勝負：01437_shoubu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挑|いど}んだ→挑む：12708_idomu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦あっさり→あっさり：05650_assari⟧{返|かえ}り{討|う}ちにあって⟦{泣|な}いていた→泣く：00655_naku⟧。
examples.english: My younger brother challenged our older brother but was easily beaten and ended up crying.

notes:
Made of {返|かえ}り (returning) + ⟦{討|う}ち→討つ：14820_utsu⟧ (striking down), from ⟦{討|う}つ→討つ：14820_utsu⟧. The roles matter: the attacker suffers {返|かえ}り{討|う}ち, the defender gives it.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {返|かえ}り{討|う}ちにあう: to be beaten by the one you attacked
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{返|かえ}り{討|う}ち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to beat an attacker or challenger

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{敵討|かたきう}ち→敵討ち：17732_katakiuchi⟧: revenge, avenging (the attempt itself)
- ⟦{反撃|はんげき}→反撃：11944_hangeki⟧: counterattack
- ⟦{仕返|しかえ}し→仕返し：10597_shikaeshi⟧: getting back at someone, payback
